Broncos vs Chiefs Betting History

The Denver Broncos and Kansas City Chiefs have met 120 times since the 1966 season. The Chiefs lead the series 63-57. Against the closing spread the Broncos are 53-63-2 (Chiefs 63-53-2), and the over is 42-47-4 in meetings with a closing total. Last meeting: Sep 14, 2026, Chiefs 31-10.
